sense_decisions.polish: Taught as the cleaning verb: buffing a leather shoe to a shine. The Japanese gloss lists Poland, but the chapter is about chores.
sense_decisions.dishwasher: Taught as the kitchen appliance, consistent with load the dishwasher and unload the dishwasher, despite the Japanese gloss listing a dishwashing worker.
sense_decisions.dust: Taught as the noun for fine particles, not the verb meaning to dust a surface.
sense_decisions.tidy: Taught as the adjective meaning neat and orderly; the illustration shows an already organized shelf.
sense_decisions.vacuum: Taught as the cleaning verb despite the Japanese gloss for vacuum; a person operates an upright vacuum.
sense_decisions.vacuum cleaner: Taught as the appliance noun, separated from the person using one and the carpet-focused cleaning action.
sense_decisions.bleach: Shown as a laundry whitening product used on fabric, following the cleaning supplies group.
sense_decisions.cloth: Shown as a cleaning rag rather than cloth as general fabric, following the cleaning supplies group.
sense_decisions.sponge: Shown as a synthetic cleaning sponge, not the marine animal in the Japanese gloss.
sense_decisions.peg: Shown as a small wooden wall peg holding a coat, following the Japanese hook/peg sense and distinguishing it from the spring drying clip.
sense_decisions.trash: Shown as household rubbish, consistent with the cleaning and disposal group, rather than the figurative Japanese gloss.
sense_decisions.shop and store: Treated as near-synonyms but illustrated with different scale: shop is a small boutique with a window display; store is a larger general store with a shopping cart.

contrast_notes.chores_household_chores: Chores uses a set of task cues; household chores shows a person carrying out a task.
contrast_notes.cleaning_clean_up_tidy: Cleaning shows wiping a surface, clean up shows putting toys into a container, and tidy describes an orderly shelf with no one arranging it.
contrast_notes.sweep_mop_scrub: Sweeping uses a stiff broom head, mopping uses loose absorbent strands on a wet floor, and scrubbing uses a stiff brush pressed against a dirty floor.
contrast_notes.vacuum_vacuum_the_carpet_vacuum_cleaner: Vacuum shows a person operating an upright cleaner; vacuum the carpet focuses on a canister vacuum nozzle crossing a carpet; vacuum cleaner isolates the upright appliance.
contrast_notes.polish_wipe_down: Polish shows buffing a shoe until it shines; wipe down shows a cloth cleaning a refrigerator door.
contrast_notes.clear_table_do_dishes_dry_dishes: Clear the table gathers used tableware; do the dishes shows hand-washing at a sink; dry the dishes shows a towel around a rinsed plate.
contrast_notes.dishwasher_load_unload: The dishwasher card isolates the open appliance; load the dishwasher moves a dish into the rack; unload the dishwasher lifts a clean dish out.
contrast_notes.set_table_clear_table: Set the table shows orderly place settings being prepared; clear the table shows used dishes being gathered.
contrast_notes.change_sheets_make_bed: Change the sheets peels an old sheet away and has fresh linen ready; make the bed smooths a blanket and arranges pillows.
contrast_notes.clothes_line_drying_clip_peg_hang_clothe: Clothes line is the supported cord, drying clip is the spring clamp, peg is a wooden wall hook, and hang clothes shows a person placing laundry on a line.
contrast_notes.bin_liner_garbage_bag: Bin liner is folded over the rim inside a bin; garbage bag is a separate tied bag of rubbish.
contrast_notes.broom_brush_duster_mop: Broom has a long handle and stiff broad bristles; brush is short-handled; duster has a soft fluffy head; mop has loose cloth strands.
contrast_notes.scouring_pad_sponge: Scouring pad is a flat coarse green abrasive pad; sponge is a soft, yellow porous block.
contrast_notes.recycling_recycling_bin: Recycling shows sorted materials within a cycle of arrows; recycling bin isolates the collection container.
contrast_notes.shop_store_go_to_shops_go_to_store: Shop is a small boutique and store is a larger general shop; go to the shops shows a street with multiple storefronts, while go to the store shows one destination.
